title: Causal Discontinuity / Residue Bridges the Break

source_refs.author: David Lynch
source_refs.title: Lost Highway; Mulholland Drive; Twin Peaks

observed_structure: identity or setting changes across a formal break
one material, sonic, or behavioral residue survives the discontinuity
the surviving residue supplies causal pressure without fully explaining the transformation
cinematic_affordances: hard transition with one retained sound
new location containing an old object trace
light or electrical rhythm surviving scene replacement
cultural_scope: film-derived formal pattern; cite Lynch and do not imitate specific iconography
misuse_risks: surface copying of red curtains or electrical imagery
transferable_structure: a discontinuity changes identity or world state while a persistent residue carries unresolved causal pressure across the break
non_transferable_surface: red rooms, zigzag floors, mystery boxes, blue keys, or direct recreations of Lynch imagery
